title: Canonical P3E container gate definition
purpose: Establish the canonical identifier set for the P3E container gates and record, per gate, what can be established from evidence. This file defines gates only; it records no execution result. Gate execution state lives in CONTAINER_RUNTIME_CAPABILITY.json and CONTAINER_COMPLETION_LIVE_STATE.json.
scope: exactly C2 and C4 through C19 (17 identifiers). C1 and C3 are deliberately out of scope: neither appears in any P3E record.
alias_basis: owner decision by rasaha on 2026-08-29: C16-image and C17-image are deprecated, noncanonical aliases of C16 and C17 and are not distinct additional gates. This is a ratified decision, not a reconstruction from evidence.

reconstruction_method.finding: None of the permitted sources contains any C-prefixed gate identifier. A case-insensitive search for C-identifiers across the workflow, the deployment test suite and the CI scripts returns no match, so no source associates any identifier with any step or test.
reconstruction_method.corroborating_finding: verify_container.sh annotates its checks with section markers of a 'P3E completion' specification (sections 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 13). That specification is not present in the repository, and section numbers are a different numbering scheme from the C identifiers; they are recorded here as a lead, not as a mapping.
reconstruction_method.counting_check: the container job carries 13 named steps, of which 12 predate the pin-conformance guard added alongside this definition, and two of those are setup rather than verification (install-e2e-driver-deps and the checkout/setup actions). That is fewer named steps than the 17 gate identifiers, so no positional or one-to-one correspondence can be derived either.
reconstruction_method.consequence: every gate's requirement, workflow step and supporting test is recorded as UNKNOWN. No mapping was invented.
